name: default an unrecognized view to history instead of upcoming, so ?view=zzz silently renders the wrong destination
old: normalized_view = view if view in VALID_VIEWS else "upcoming"
new: normalized_view = view if view in VALID_VIEWS else "history"

name: drop the page multiplier from history's offset, so page 1 re-slices from row 1 instead of row page_size
offer Retry on every terminal row regardless of retryable, so a cancelled or already-retried run gets a control that can only 409
ignore the status filter, so History shows every terminal row regardless of ?status=
old:
if active_status is not None:
            terminal = [r for r in terminal if r["status"] == active_status]
new:
if False:
            terminal = [r for r in terminal if r["status"] == active_status]

name: trust the raw status even when it names no terminal row, so ?status=bogus filters History to empty
old: active_status = status if status in facet_counts else None
